highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 delivers the stable m116-based release with modern .NET and WebAssembly support.
highlights_body: It rolls up the 3.0 previews, including new graphics APIs, view improvements, and the removal of obsolete v2 APIs.

breaking.title: Obsolete v2 APIs were removed
breaking.body: Deprecated graphics, text, bitmap, codec, and OpenGL APIs are no longer available. Replace each call with the successor named in the API diff before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy Index8 bitmap support was removed
breaking.body: Color-table and Index8 bitmap and codec overloads are gone. Use supported color types and the current pixel installation and decoding overloads.

bullets.detail: Ships the cumulative m116 engine update from the 3.0 preview line.
Adds span overloads for mapping points and vectors and for building polygon paths.
Adds multithread and SIMD WebAssembly support and fixes Blazor applications hosted beneath a base path.
Fixes MAUI and Uno canvas behavior, Apple Metal snapshots, kerning, and cloned paint disposal.
